chunks: Ahmad ibn Ziyad ibn Ja'far al-Hamdani (may God have mercy on him) narrated to us. He said: 'Ali ibn Ibrahim ibn Hashim narrated to us. He said: Ja'far ibn Salama al-Ahwazi narrated to us. He said: Ibrahim ibn Muhammad al-Thaqafi narrated to us from Ibrahim ibn Musa, the son of the sister of al-Waqidi. He said: Abu Qatada al-Harrani narrated to us from 'Abd al-Rahman

ibn al-'Ala' al-Hadrami from Sa'id ibn al-Musayyib from Ibn 'Abbas. He said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) was sitting one day, and with him were 'Ali, Fatima, al-Hasan, and al-Husayn (peace be upon them all). So he said: O Allah! You know that these are my Ahl al-Bayt and the dearest of people to me. So love those who love them, hate those who hate them, align with those who align with them, oppose those who oppose them, and support those who support them. Make them purified from every uncleanliness and protected from every sin. Aid them with the Holy Spirit.

Then he (peace be upon him and his family) said: O 'Ali! You are the Imam of my nation and my vicegerent over it after me. You are the leader of the believers to Paradise. It is as though I see my daughter Fatima coming forth on the Day of Resurrection on a noble mount of light. To her right will be seventy thousand angels, to her left seventy thousand angels, before her seventy thousand angels, and behind her seventy thousand angels — leading the believing women of my nation to Paradise. Whichever woman prays five prayers in the day and night, fasts the month of Ramadan, makes pilgrimage to the Sacred House of Allah, gives zakat on her wealth, obeys her husband, and aligns with 'Ali after me — she will enter Paradise by the intercession of my daughter Fatima. She is truly the Mistress of the Women of the Worlds.

It was said to him: O Messenger of Allah! Is she the Mistress of the Women of her own world? The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said: That is for Maryam daughter of 'Imran. As for my daughter Fatima, she is the Mistress of the Women of the Worlds — from the first to the last. She will stand in her prayer niche, and seventy thousand angels from the nearest angels will greet her with salaam. They will call to her just as the angels called to Maryam, saying: 'O Fatima! Indeed Allah has chosen you, purified you, and chosen you above the women of the worlds.' [3:42] Then he turned to 'Ali (peace be upon him) and said: O 'Ali! Fatima is a part of me. She is the light of my eye and the fruit of my heart. What harms her harms me, and what brings her joy brings me joy. She is the first who will join me from my Ahl al-Bayt, so be good to her after me.

As for al-Hasan and al-Husayn, they are my two sons and my two sweet basils, and they are the two Masters of the Youth of Paradise. So let them be honored by you like your hearing and your sight.' Then he, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him and his family, raised his hand toward the sky and said: 'O Allah! I call You to witness that I am a lover of whoever loves them, and a hater of whoever hates them, and at peace with whoever is at peace with them, and at war with whoever makes war on them, and an enemy of whoever is their enemy, and an ally of whoever aligns with them.'

key_terms.أَهْلُ الْبَيْتِ: Ahl al-Bayt — The Household of the Prophet, specifically 'Ali, Fatima, Hasan, and Husayn
key_terms.بَضْعَةٌ مِنِّي: A part of me — the Prophet's statement that Fatima is an extension of himself
key_terms.رُوحُ الْقُدُسِ: The Holy Spirit — a divine support granted to the Ahl al-Bayt
key_terms.سَيِّدَةُ نِسَاءِ الْعَالَمِينَ: Mistress of the Women of the Worlds — Fatima's supreme rank among all women in history
key_terms.شَفَاعَة: Intercession — Fatima's role in interceding for believing women on the Day of Judgment
key_terms.مَعْصُومِينَ مِنْ كُلِّ ذَنْبٍ: Protected from every sin — the doctrine of 'ismah (infallibility)

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet say about 'Ali, Fatima, Hasan and Husayn seated with him?
ai.summary: This hadith, narrated through a long chain reaching Ibn 'Abbas, presents the Prophet Muhammad's public declaration of his love and honor for his Ahl al-Bayt — 'Ali, Fatima, Hasan, and Husayn — while they were seated together. The Prophet supplicated to Allah to purify them, protect them from sin, and support them with the Holy Spirit, then directly addressed 'Ali as the Imam and vicegerent of the community after him. He described a vision of Fatima on the Day of Resurrection surrounded by angels and leading believing women to Paradise, declared her the Mistress of all Women from the first to the last, and spoke of the intercession she would provide for pious women who observed the five pillars and showed loyalty to 'Ali. This gathering in Medina represents a foundational moment for Shia doctrine on the Imamate, the 'ismah (infallibility) of the Ahl al-Bayt, and Fatima's unique eschatological role.
